fusions.name: Toying Nip
fusions.desc: A light strike with your weapon that deals 4 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds and slows it by 15% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Done Playing
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. A killing bite that deals 20 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit.

fusions.name: Padding Circuit
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds and raises your movement speed by 20%. Enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Slip, Then Bite
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 3% more damage per stack (15% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
